poseidon.winCondition: Pull enables AoE cluster -- chain waterspouts scale with relic. Poseidon + Set mastery defines elite PvE pushing.

yanluo.winCondition: Pull and energy removal syncs with Nezha burst at r10. r20 counters energy-cycling enemies.

pan.winCondition: Perma-CC via energy removal. r20 enables advanced counter-tech vs energy-cycling enemies.

diana.winCondition: Crescent Mark armor debuff is disproportionately strong due to armor scaling. Energy battery function pairs with Zeus/Nezha.

momus.winCondition: Continuous shielding without GCD at 25% gain rate. Stats scale directly with Hecate output.

tefnut.winCondition: Only pure cleanser in game. 50% AoE damage reduction plus cleanse covers otherwise unplayable fight scenarios.

set.winCondition: Armor shred on Poseidon-grouped enemies is the Diamond PvE core. Understanding Set separates mediocre from elite pushers.

nuba.winCondition: Off-tank sub-DPS with layered utility. Without dupe and relic investment she feeds enemy energy.

hladgunnr.winCondition: Line-hold mechanic enables damage exploitation on specific stages. Stat dampening limits PvE ceiling.

jormungandr.winCondition: Currently used as grouping tool only. True damage mechanic bugged.

hela.winCondition: Carry requires Poseidon + Khepri + Iris setup. Skadi performs the same role with less investment.

scorpio.winCondition: Comparable damage to low-dupe Nyx at Divine. Rating diverges significantly between EN and CN community.
